text:
arjun: Heads up — noticed a fairness drift after last abuse-score normalizer rollout. Some mid-tier tenants saw 20-30% throttling increase overnight. Anyone else see this?

maria: yeah saw it on dashboards. guessing smoothing window too short, makes scores reactive to spikey behavior. :thinking:

sam: curious if the new model-based detector's output scale changed. we retrained and might have different base rate.

li: agree w/ Maria. suggest isolating smoothing & threshold so we can tweak without retraining the detector.

arjun: proposal: apply a 24h EWMA on score, but feed raw score to offline evals. live admission uses EWMA. thoughts?

maria: +1. also need to keep headroom for bursts — maybe adaptive threshold: thresh = base + k*stddev(window)

katie: ops: any config knobs we can flip quickly?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Feature flag 'abuse_score_ewma' toggled on 1761121111 by katie. Rolling update in progress. :eyes:

sam: if we go EWMA, need to ensure latency of detection not compromised. details: window_seconds=86400, alpha=0.01 maybe.

li: can we simulate with replay infra? I can run 48h replay with current and EWMA weights.

arjun: li please run replay and post metric diffs (throttle_rate by tenant, false_positive proxy) — if negative impact <1% we flip.

maria: also add a canary rollout to 10% of capacity and monitor per-tenant throttle variance.

katie: noted. I'll create canary and add alert on thermal increase + 3s p95 response.

sam: one more: decouple score -> quota mapping into a small lambda service so we can A/B different mapping functions without touching detector. example mapping snippet:

// mapping pseudo-config
// {"raw_score":0.72, "ewma_score":0.58, "quota_factor": max(0.1, 1 - 0.5 * ewma_score)}

arjun: yep that's ideal. plan: li run replay, sam drafts lambda shim PR, katie sets canary, maria defines eval metrics. I'll sync tomorrow 11am. Thanks :thumbsup:

incidents-bot: Incident #423: throttle-surge detected. Auto-created runbook.
